description: This file contains React components and related logic for rendering and managing context menus within the Notesnook project, including Menu, MenuPresenter, and LazyLoader components, as well as associated utility functions and subcomponents.

methods.name: Menu
methods.description: Main component rendering a context menu with items, handling focus, submenus, and actions.

methods.name: MenuPresenter
methods.description: Component that wraps Menu with popup presentation logic, handling open/close and positioning.

methods.name: LazyLoader
methods.description: Component for asynchronously loading menu items and rendering them once loaded.
